title: S 级核心词 · 第 24 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 40 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.zh: vt. 支持，为…提供支撑的证据或信息，加固，增强；n. 支撑物，扶壁，支柱
items.en: to support or strengthen with evidence or structure
items.root: butt(顶、撞) + -ress → 顶住墙的支墩 → 支撑

items.zh: 监禁，禁闭，幽禁；使闭门不出，（使）与世隔绝
items.en: to shut in; to confine as if in walls
items.root: im-(在里) + mur(墙) + -e → 关在墙里 → 禁闭

items.zh: 相称，同等，平等，对等，（货币）平价，（奇偶）校验
items.en: equality, especially of status or amount
items.root: par(同等) + -ity(名词) → 平等

items.zh: 初始的，未发展的，基础的，最基本的，（器官等）退化的，不发达的
items.en: basic, undeveloped
items.root: rudiment(基础) + -ary(……的) → 初始的
rel: rude 粗鲁的(原指未加工)

items.zh: 使僵化，使失去活力，使惊呆（尤指因恐惧），使石化，使吓呆
items.en: to make rigid, lifeless, or frozen with fear
items.root: petr(石头) + -ify(使) → 变成石头 → 吓呆

blocks.text: He sought to [[buttress]] his claim, yet the council would [[immure]] him in silence; the offered [[parity]] was [[rudimentary]], and the long delay began to [[petrify]] the talks.

gloss.buttress: 为…提供支撑的证据或者信息

items.zh: vt. 容忍，赞许，支持，默许；n. 面容，面部表情，支持，赞成
items.en: to tolerate or approve
items.root: count-(一起) + ten(握) + -ance(名词) → 脸上保持的样子 → 容忍

items.zh: 伴随的，同时发生的，并存的；n. 伴随物，伴随而来的事物
items.en: occurring together with something else

items.zh: 迥然不同的，根本不同的，无法比较的
items.en: so different as to be hard to compare
items.root: dis-(分开) + par(同等) + -ate(……的) → 不能同等看待的 → 迥然不同的

items.zh: 隐蔽的，秘密的，暗中的，不公开的，隐秘的
items.en: hidden or secret
items.root: co-(完全) + vert(= ouvert，打开的反义) → 盖上的 → 隐蔽的

items.zh: 磨蹭，逗留，徘徊，缓慢消失，（疾病、习惯、疑虑等）挥之不去，持续
items.en: to stay longer than needed; to be slow to leave

blocks.text: The board would not [[countenance]] a [[concomitant]] rise in fees for such [[disparate]] groups; the [[covert]] plan was dropped, and its backers did not [[linger]].

items.zh: 偶然发生的，非故意的，疏忽的，不留意的
items.en: done without intention or thought
items.root: in-(不) + ad-(向) + vert(转) + -ent(……的) → 没有转过去注意 → 非故意的

items.zh: n. 污蔑，诽谤，中伤，含糊不清地说；vt. 含糊地说，诋毁，连音
items.en: an insulting remark that damages reputation; to speak unclearly

items.zh: 编造，捏造，虚构，调制，策划，炮制
items.en: to invent or make up, often a story or plan
items.root: con-(一起) + coct(煮) → 一起煮 → 调制；编造

items.zh: 歪曲，误传，篡改，不实地表达，错误地描述
items.en: to give a false or misleading account of
items.root: mis-(错) + re-(再) + present(呈现) → 错误地呈现

items.zh: n. 同等地位的人，同辈，同龄人，贵族；vi. 凝视，仔细看，（费力地）看
items.en: an equal in rank or ability; to look closely
items.root: par(同等) → 地位相同的人

blocks.text: An [[inadvertent]] [[slur]] spread when a rival chose to [[concoct]] a story and [[misrepresent]] her words; the [[peers|peer]] who read it were not fooled.

items.zh: 厌恶，憎恨，极其讨厌
items.en: to feel intense disgust or hatred for
items.root: loath(讨厌) 的动词形式 → 厌恶

items.zh: 谩骂，责骂，痛斥，诋毁
items.en: to attack with harsh, abusive words
items.root: vitu(缺点) + per-(完全) + -ate(动词) → 专挑缺点来骂 → 痛斥

items.zh: 笨重的，沉重的，沉闷的，（文体等）冗长乏味的，缓慢的
items.en: heavy, slow, and dull
items.root: pond(重量) + -erous(……的) → 沉重的

items.zh: 渴望的，怀念的，惆怅的，若有所思的，哀怨的
items.en: full of vague, melancholy longing

items.zh: 幸灾乐祸，自鸣得意，沾沾自喜，扬扬得意地盯着
items.en: to take smug pleasure in someone's misfortune

blocks.text: Critics who [[loathe]] him still [[vituperate]] his [[ponderous]] prose; he looks back with a [[wistful]] smile and refuses to [[gloat]] over his later success.

items.zh: 易怒的，暴躁的，脾气暴躁的
items.en: easily angered
items.root: chol(胆汁) + -eric(……的) → 古人认为胆汁多则易怒

items.zh: 表示怜悯，同情，（与某人）共同悲伤，（对不幸）表示安慰
items.en: to express sympathy for someone's distress
items.root: com-(一起) + miser(可怜) + -ate(动词) → 一起觉得可怜 → 同情

items.zh: 尊敬，敬意，敬重，（对某人的）臣服，（尤指）公开的尊敬
items.en: respect or honor shown publicly
items.root: hom(人) + -age(名词) → 对主人宣誓效忠的「人」 → 敬意

items.zh: （头发、皮毛）光滑的，时髦的，（外形）流线型的，优美的，（人）油滑的
items.en: smooth, glossy, and well-shaped

items.zh: 诋毁，污蔑，贬低，抹黑，轻视
items.en: to criticize unfairly; to belittle
items.root: de-(完全) + nigr(黑) + -ate(使) → 把别人抹黑 → 诋毁

blocks.text: The [[choleric]] coach did not [[commiserate]] with the losers, but he paid [[homage]] to the [[sleek]] champion team and refused to [[denigrate]] their win.

items.zh: 固执的，倔强的，冷酷无情的，顽固不化的
items.en: stubbornly unwilling to change one's mind
items.root: ob-(对着) + dur(硬) + -ate(……的) → 硬着对抗的 → 固执的

items.zh: 搅混，使混浊，（使）翻腾，激怒，使烦恼
items.en: to make muddy or agitated; to disturb

items.zh: 狂妄自大，傲慢，（过度的）自负，骄横
items.en: excessive pride or self-confidence
items.root: 来自希腊语 hybris(狂妄、侮辱) → 狂妄自大

items.zh: adj. 无害的，不得罪人的，平淡无奇的，止痛的；n. 止痛药，安慰物
items.en: not likely to offend; bland; something that soothes pain
items.root: an-(无) + odyn(痛) + -e → 无痛的 → 止痛药；无害的

items.zh: n. 偏袒者，党羽，有偏见的人，游击队员；adj. 偏袒的，党派的，盲目支持的
items.en: strongly loyal to one side; a committed supporter
items.root: part(部分) + -isan(人) → 站在某一边的人 → 偏袒者

blocks.text: The [[obdurate]] mayor was quick to [[roil]] the crowd; his [[hubris]] met only an [[anodyne]] reply from a [[partisan]] aide.

items.zh: （因为有罪孽或过错而）后悔悲痛的，悔恨的，悔过的
items.en: feeling remorse for having done wrong
items.root: con-(完全) + trit(磨) + -e → 心被磨碎的 → 痛悔的

items.zh: 报复，反击，回敬，还击
items.en: to strike back in return for harm

items.zh: 重大的，极重要的，重要的，具有重大意义的
items.en: of great importance or consequence
items.root: moment(动力、重要) + -ous(……的) → 重大的

items.zh: 严厉批评，反复地做（说）以至于过度，抨击，喋喋不休地谈论
items.en: to go on about too long; to attack with words or blows
items.root: be-(加强) + labor(劳动) → 反复使劲弄

items.zh: 杰出人物，名人，有影响的人，发光体
items.en: a person of outstanding achievement and influence
items.root: lumin(光) + -ary(人) → 发光者 → 杰出人物

blocks.text: The [[contrite]] chairman vowed not to [[retaliate]] after the [[momentous]] vote; he did not [[belabor]] the point, and the [[luminary]] who had backed him nodded.

gloss.contrite: (因为有罪孽或过错而感到)后悔悲痛的

items.zh: 无关紧要的，不重要的，不相干的，非物质的，无形的
items.en: having no importance or relevance
items.root: im-(不) + material(物质、要紧的) → 不要紧的 → 无关紧要的

items.zh: 冷静的，淡定的，平静的，安静的，温和的
items.en: calm and not easily upset
items.root: plac(平静、使高兴) + -id(……的) → 平静的

items.zh: 预言，占卜，预测，预见，神谕
items.en: the practice of foretelling the future
items.root: div(神) + -in- + -ation(名词) → 与神沟通 → 占卜

items.zh: 使混合，合并，混为一谈，把…合成一体
items.en: to merge two things into one, often wrongly
items.root: con-(一起) + fla(吹) + -te → 吹到一起 → 合并

items.zh: 怂恿，鼓励，教唆，帮助，支持（常指坏事、犯罪）
items.en: to help or encourage, usually in wrongdoing
items.root: a-(ad-，向) + bet(咬、使咬) → 怂恿狗去咬 → 唆使

blocks.text: His rank was [[immaterial]] to the [[placid]] monk, who thought [[divination]] a way to [[conflate]] hope with fact and would never [[abet]] such claims.

questions.explain: denigrate：诋毁，污蔑，贬低，抹黑，轻视（to criticize unfairly; to belittle）。近义词：disparage, belittle。
abet：怂恿，鼓励，教唆，帮助，支持（常指坏事、犯罪）（to help or encourage, usually in wrongdoing）。近义词：assist, instigate。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「严厉批评；喋喋不休」？
questions.explain: belabor：严厉批评，反复地做（说）以至于过度，抨击，喋喋不休地谈论（to go on about too long; to attack with words or blows）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **testy** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: choleric 与 testy 近义：easily angered。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> The board would not countenance a concomitant rise in fees for such disparate groups; the covert plan was dropped, and its backers did not ____.
questions.explain: linger：磨蹭，逗留，徘徊，缓慢消失，（疾病、习惯、疑虑等）挥之不去，持续（to stay longer than needed; to be slow to leave）。
